source_evidence: Current src/playerlock.cpp:50 already carries the native product binding for PlayerLock::lock at 0x00590000–0x00590093; the original seed and its history remain in src/unrecovered/00590000.cpp. Another seed binding is unnecessary.

The product implementation uses the two declared SquareLock members, resets each in flag/second/first order, clears active_, acquires entries in order, and unlocks both on either failure before clearing active_ and returning 1. Both successful acquisitions return 0; src/playerlock.h declares the seven-argument method.

Fresh installed-framework inspect with --in src/playerlock.cpp exited 0, verified the pinned image and decoded all 147 bytes. Original calls at 0x00590041 and 0x0059005A establish ordered acquisition; the loop at 0x00590071–0x0059007D establishes two-entry rollback.

This finding concerns an identity and files already in task scope. Incorporation records the implemented insight only. Supplied diagnostics still exit 3: Lock::lock fails byte/reference checks, message_data remains unresolved, and layout/build/runtime proof remains incomplete. Both cross-owner discoveries remain pending; no code acceptance, outside ownership transfer or baseline change is proposed.
